questions.q: What does "code is law" actually mean for a deployed smart contract?
options: Once deployed, the contract's code can never be changed — it does exactly what it says, no exceptions
Contracts are reviewed by a court before deployment
The contract can be edited freely by its original developer
Only government-approved contracts can be deployed
questions.explain: Smart contracts are immutable once deployed — whatever the code says is exactly what happens, with no way to directly edit it afterward.

questions.q: If a deployed contract has a bug, what is the real workaround developers use?
options: Directly edit the old contract's code on the blockchain
Ask Ethereum validators to roll back the bug
Deploy an entirely new contract (the upgrade pattern) and direct users to use it instead
There is no possible workaround
questions.explain: Since a contract's code can't be changed after deployment, developers use the upgrade pattern: deploying a new contract and migrating users to it.

questions.q: What is the ABI, and what does it actually connect?
options: The Ethereum blockchain's consensus mechanism
A type of cryptocurrency wallet
A tool for mining new blocks
The Application Binary Interface — it connects a front end to a deployed smart contract
questions.explain: The ABI is a JSON-formatted description of a contract's functions and events, acting as the bridge between front-end code and the deployed contract.

questions.q: What two real factors determine how much gas a transaction actually costs, per this lesson's recap?
options: Only the price of Bitcoin
Gas cost is always a fixed, unchanging amount
The time of year and the developer's reputation
How busy the network is, and how well the contract's code is written
questions.explain: Network congestion drives gas prices up or down, and poorly optimized contract code costs more gas to deploy and use than well-optimized code.

questions.q: What is JSON, as defined live in this lesson?
options: A type of Ethereum wallet
A programming language used to write smart contracts
A lightweight, structured, human-readable data format that represents data as key-value pairs
A blockchain consensus algorithm
questions.explain: JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is a data format built from key-value pairs, widely used in web development and APIs — and it's exactly the format an ABI is written in.
